verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs explicitly state built-in package registry support for over 20 formats (Cargo, npm, Maven, PyPI, Container, Helm, NuGet, RubyGems, etc.) hosted natively on the same platform as repos, PRs, and issues, enabling maintainers to publish/consume packages without a separate tool. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community confirmation of the package registry feature in the evidence pack, and no detail on publish/consume workflow specifics.
